subject: Co-sell entitlement & cloud marketplace listing intake
messages:
From: Sanjay Patel <sanjay@cloudforge.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lena Müller <lena.mueller@equinox-tech.de>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Co-sell + AWS listing: evidence & next steps

Hi Aditya,

Thanks again for taking the time last week. CloudForge is ready to move forward with a combined marketplace listing and a co-sell commitment for our new Embeddings SKU. Before we start the AWS/Google listing flows, the marketplace team needs a small intake bundle so they can validate entitlement, metering, and co-sell competency eligibility.

Attached is our partner pitch deck (CloudForge_Partner_PitchDeck.pdf) and a quick product spec. To help us land the listing in Q4, can you confirm:
- The required evidentiary items for "co-sell with Redwood" (SOC2, sample billing metering config, partner agreement template)
- Which Redwood contacts will own the marketplace submission vs co-sell enablement
- Any mandatory SKU naming or entitlement mapping constraints for Reserved/Dedicated customers

We'd like to target an intake submission by Sept 22. If that schedule doesn't work, please propose alternatives.

Thanks,
Sanjay Patel
Head of Partnerships, CloudForge
--Attachment: CloudForge_Partner_PitchDeck.pdf (pdf)--
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Sanjay Patel <sanjay@cloudforge.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Co-sell + AWS listing: evidence & next steps

Sanjay — great to hear, excited to get this moving. Quick answers up front:
1) Evidence set: SOC2 Type II (redacted ok), sample metering config (CSV of usage tiers), sample invoice template, security questionnaire (we'll provide our inbound form).
2) Owners: Marketplace intake (catalog submission) = Olga Petrov (cc'd). Co-sell enablement (sales play / partner enablement) = Ben Carter. I'll own the commercial/contract side and the mutual action plan.
3) SKU naming: avoid spaces and keep a short prefix (eg CF-EMB-<tier>). We'll need a mapping table for Reserved vs PayG variants.

I'll attach our intake checklist and a draft mutual action plan. Can everyone review and confirm by EOD Friday (Sept 17)? If we can hit Sept 22 for the formal intake, that should be workable.

Next steps (proposal):
- Olga to run the technical/permissions intake against AWS/GCP requirement list (due Sept 17)
- Ben to prepare co-sell enablement assets (playbook, demo kit) by Sept 21
- Aditya to circulate draft MPA and pricing guardrails for signature (target Sept 24)

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Director, Partnerships — Redwood Inference
--Attachment: Redwood_Marketplace_Intake_Checklist.xlsx (xlsx)--
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Sanjay Patel <sanjay@cloudforge.ai>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Co-sell + AWS listing: evidence & next steps

Quick note from the enablement side — we should align on two things early: demo entitlement mapping (who can demo what under joint accounts) and co-sell crediting (how leads route). I opened a Jira ticket to capture the mapping: https://jira.redwood.com/browse/MP-1189.

Technical asks for the marketplace listing:
- Public SKU manifest (JSON) with pricing tiers and metering hook URL
- Docker image URI or approved AMI for marketplace packaging (if needed for the GCP/Azure offering)
- A contact for procurement/pro-forma invoice questions (CloudForge finance)

Sanjay — if you can provide a short JSON manifest and the invoicing contact, I can spin up the demo kit and the co-sell play by Sept 21.

Ben
Senior GTM Partnerships, Redwood Inference
From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Sanjay Patel <sanjay@cloudforge.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 16 Sep 2026 10:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Co-sell + AWS listing: evidence & next steps

Thanks team — I've started the AWS intake checklist. For marketplace gating, AWS will require:
- Redacted SOC2 Type II (ok to redact client lists)
- A metering verification doc and at least one metering test case
- Business contact for partner onboarding (marketplace-ops@aws-partners.amazon.com or equivalent)

I've attached our copy of the SOC2 evidence we ask partners to include (CF-SOC2-2026-redacted.pdf) and a short template for meter verification. Sanjay — please confirm you can provide a test run (small sample file) and a redacted SOC2 by Sept 17. I will also kick off the catalog entry and will likely need the SKU manifest Ben requested.

Note: For EU listings, there are additional invoicing/regulatory fields — Marissa, can you advise on VAT/po-terms we should expect?

Olga
Marketplace Program Manager, Redwood Inference
--Attachment: CF-SOC2-2026-redacted.pdf (pdf)--
From: Lena Müller <lena.mueller@equinox-tech.de>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 17 Sep 2026 08:03:00 +02:00
Subject: Re: Co-sell + AWS listing: evidence & next steps

Hi all,

Thanks for the clear owners. Quick update from CloudForge (EU office):
- Attached: CF-Invoicing_Terms_EU.pdf (contains VAT handling preferences and PO requirements).
- We can produce the redacted SOC2 and a metering sample by end of day Sept 17 (confirming Olga's ask).
- For EU co-sell competency: are there any additional Redwood enablement requirements (training certs, local case studies) to unlock EU co-sell motion?

If the intake is submitted by Sept 22, what's a realistic timeline to appear in the AWS store and to enable co-sell lead routing? We need to plan sales coverage for Oct.

Cheers,
Lena Müller
Head of Channel, CloudForge — EU
--Attachment: CF-Invoicing_Terms_EU.pdf (pdf)--
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Sanjay Patel <sanjay@cloudforge.ai>, Lena Müller <lena.mueller@equinox-tech.de>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, marketplace-ops@aws-partners.amazon.com
Date: Fri, 18 Sep 2026 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Co-sell + AWS listing: evidence & next steps

All — thanks for the fast responses and for the attachments. Summary & owners (final):
- Olga: submit marketplace intake (AWS & GCP) by Sept 22 — needs JSON SKU manifest + metering sample from CloudForge (action: Sanjay/Lena)
- Ben: complete co-sell playbook and demo entitlement mapping by Sept 21 (action: Ben)
- Marissa: confirm EU VAT/PO templates and local sales support request by Sept 20 (action: Marissa)
- Aditya: circulate draft MPA and pricing guardrails for signature (MPA-Draft.docx attached) — target send Sept 24; route to legal for redlines (action: Aditya)
- Vivek: run partner onboarding checklist for enterprise customers and confirm dedicated capacity routing (action: Vivek)

Timeline expectations: if intake completes Sept 22 and AWS processing takes the usual 7–10 business days, visibility in the AWS catalog could occur in early Oct. Co-sell routing (partner lead cred) typically takes an additional ~1 week after catalog publish for the co-sell ops to flip routing. We'll flag any gating items early.

Sanjay/Lena — please upload the SOC2 redaction and a metering sample to the shared Drive link: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/marketplace/DEAL-2026-1423/intake-checklist. Once Olga starts the intake I'll coordinate cross-team review.

I'll also attach the MPA draft here for quick review. If all looks good we'll send to docuSign the week of Sept 27.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Director, Partnerships — Redwood Inference
--Attachment: MPA-Draft.docx (docx)--
--DocuSign link: https://app.docusign.com/Mpa/CF-2026-1423--
